activities.title: Airport transfer to the hotel
activities.description: Private car from Sharm El Sheikh airport to the hotel in Naama Bay, about 20 minutes.

activities.title: Hotel check-in
activities.description: Drop the bags, freshen up and pick up the hotel map.

activities.title: Late lunch at Farsha Cafe
activities.description: Grilled fish and mezze on the terrace, a good first taste of the local seafood.

activities.title: Walk along the Naama Bay promenade
activities.description: An easy evening walk past the shops and cafes by the water.

activities.title: Snorkelling day at Ras Mohammed National Park
activities.description: A small-group boat and snorkelling trip to the coral reefs, about 40 minutes by road from Naama Bay. Park fee, boat and snorkelling gear are included.

activities.title: Seafood lunch in Naama Bay
activities.description: Fresh grilled fish and calamari at a waterfront restaurant, mild seasoning on request.

activities.title: Free time at the hotel beach
activities.description: A quiet rest on the sand before the evening.

activities.title: Taxi to the Old Market
activities.description: Short ride from the hotel to the Old Market and back, about 15 minutes each way.

activities.title: Al Sahaba Mosque and the Old Market
activities.description: See the white mosque, then wander the market stalls for spices, perfumes and photos.

activities.title: Grilled dinner at the Old Market
activities.description: Mixed grill with salads and fresh bread at a local restaurant.

activities.title: Glass-bottom boat ride at Sharks Bay
activities.description: A calm morning boat ride over the reef without needing to swim.

activities.title: Hotel check-out
activities.description: Leave the bags with reception until the afternoon.

activities.title: Farewell seafood lunch
activities.description: A last relaxed lunch of grilled fish and rice before the trip home.

activities.title: Souvenir shopping in Naama Bay
activities.description: Pick up spices, perfumes and handmade gifts from the shops near the promenade.

activities.title: Transfer to the airport
activities.description: Private car from the hotel to the airport, leaving about three hours before the flight.

flights.details: Direct flight, one cabin bag each.
Direct flight, one cabin bag each, checked bag costs extra.

hotels.name: Coral Bay Resort
hotels.details: Breakfast included, five minutes from the beach.

hotels.details: Breakfast included, free shuttle to Naama Bay twice a day.

hotels.details: Half board, private beach and spa.
